description: Demucs htdemucs_6s source separation into vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, and other, with each stem's levels: the stems program with another pinned model and six stems, a second separator beside stems. Runs under the operator's stems-6s-python (Demucs's interpreter, the same one as demucs-python will do), so the archive's environment never imports PyTorch and run all makes a second separation only where the operator asks for one.

apply.normalise: chunk mean and standard deviation, as demucs.api.Separator.separate_tensor

levels.measure: RMS over both channels of the float stem, zero outside it

vocals.description: the vocals source, as htdemucs_6s separates it: 44,100 Hz stereo, 16-bit FLAC

drums.description: the drums source, as htdemucs_6s separates it: 44,100 Hz stereo, 16-bit FLAC

bass.description: the bass source, as htdemucs_6s separates it: 44,100 Hz stereo, 16-bit FLAC

guitar.description: the guitar source, as htdemucs_6s separates it: 44,100 Hz stereo, 16-bit FLAC

piano.description: the piano source, as htdemucs_6s separates it: 44,100 Hz stereo, 16-bit FLAC

other.description: the other source, as htdemucs_6s separates it: 44,100 Hz stereo, 16-bit FLAC

levels.description: each stem's RMS level every 4,096 samples (8,192-sample frames), columns vocals, drums, bass, guitar, piano, other; floored at -120

vocals_rms_db.description: the whole vocals stem's RMS over both channels, before quantisation; floored at -120

vocals_peak_db.description: the vocals stem's sample peak before quantisation; above 0 means its FLAC clamped

vocals_clamped.description: how many samples of the vocals FLAC were clamped to 16-bit full scale

drums_rms_db.description: the whole drums stem's RMS over both channels, before quantisation; floored at -120

drums_peak_db.description: the drums stem's sample peak before quantisation; above 0 means its FLAC clamped

drums_clamped.description: how many samples of the drums FLAC were clamped to 16-bit full scale

bass_rms_db.description: the whole bass stem's RMS over both channels, before quantisation; floored at -120

bass_peak_db.description: the bass stem's sample peak before quantisation; above 0 means its FLAC clamped

bass_clamped.description: how many samples of the bass FLAC were clamped to 16-bit full scale

guitar_rms_db.description: the whole guitar stem's RMS over both channels, before quantisation; floored at -120

guitar_peak_db.description: the guitar stem's sample peak before quantisation; above 0 means its FLAC clamped

guitar_clamped.description: how many samples of the guitar FLAC were clamped to 16-bit full scale

piano_rms_db.description: the whole piano stem's RMS over both channels, before quantisation; floored at -120

piano_peak_db.description: the piano stem's sample peak before quantisation; above 0 means its FLAC clamped

piano_clamped.description: how many samples of the piano FLAC were clamped to 16-bit full scale

other_rms_db.description: the whole other stem's RMS over both channels, before quantisation; floored at -120

other_peak_db.description: the other stem's sample peak before quantisation; above 0 means its FLAC clamped

other_clamped.description: how many samples of the other FLAC were clamped to 16-bit full scale

mix_rms_db.description: the decoded input's RMS over both channels, the reference for each stem's level

samples.description: samples per channel at 44,100 Hz, in the input and in every stem
